detail.longDescription: OpenAI withdrew sponsorship of Caltech's Mathathon after 771 mathematicians objected, citing concerns about AI research practices. The event continues with other backers including Anthropic and DARPA. Whether replacement funding covers OpenAI's $10K-per-team contribution remains unclear. https://www. implicator.ai/openai-pulls-cal tech-mathathon-sponsorship-after-771-mathematicians-object/ # AI # Mathematics # Research
